name: Will converting my bathtub to a shower hurt my home's resale value?

mainEntity.name: Will converting my bathtub to a shower hurt my home's resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing the sole bathtub in a home can make it less appealing to prospective buyers with young children, potentially affecting broad resale appeal. However, if your home already features a secondary bathtub in another bathroom, converting a cramped master tub into a spacious, modern walk-in shower generally boosts buyer interest and perceived home value. For homeowners planning to age in place, the immediate daily safety, ease of cleaning, and accessibility of a walk-in shower often outweigh hypothetical resale concerns.
acceptedAnswer.description: Not if you retain at least one bathtub elsewhere in the house. Upgrading a primary bathroom to a modern walk-in shower typically improves appeal and day-to-day usability.
